CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.enforce_ssj_review_columns()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  reviewer_only_statuses text[] := ARRAY['REVIEWING','APPROVED','CONDITIONAL','REVISION_NEEDED','REJECTED'];
BEGIN
  IF (
      (NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND NEW.status = ANY(reviewer_only_statuses))
      OR NEW.review_comment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.review_comment
      OR NEW.evidence_missing IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.evidence_missing
      OR NEW.reviewed_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reviewed_by
      OR NEW.reviewed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reviewed_at
     )
     AND NOT mso_manage.has_level('management/sole-source', 'manager', 'user')
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '검토 처리는 manager 이상 권한자만 할 수 있습니다.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
name: enforce_ssj_review_columns

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.get_contract_cleanup_candidates(p_max_days integer DEFAULT 365)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, doc_no text, title text, counterparty text, owner_id uuid, owner_name text, clinic_name text, eff_end date, days_since integer, amount numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
  select t.id, t.doc_no, t.title, t.counterparty_name, t.owner_id, t.owner_name, t.clinic_name, t.eff_end,
         ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - t.eff_end)::int, t.contract_amount
  from (
    select c.id, c.doc_no, coalesce(c.contract_title, c.counterparty_name, c.doc_no) title, c.counterparty_name, c.owner_id, c.owner_name,
           coalesce(c.clinic_names_display, c.clinic_name) clinic_name, c.contract_amount,
           case when c.has_warranty='Y' and c.warranty_end > c.contract_end then c.warranty_end else c.contract_end end eff_end
    from mso_manage.contracts c
    where c.deleted_at is null and c.status='EXPIRED' and c.has_period='Y' and c.cleanup_checked_at is null
  ) t
  where t.eff_end between (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - p_max_days and (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 30
    -- 연결된 계약(후속·갱신 등)이 있으면 정리 대기에서 제외: 연결 상대가 진행 중이거나 더 늦게 끝나는 경우
    and not exists (
      select 1 from mso_manage.contract_relations r
      join mso_manage.contracts n on n.id = case when r.contract_id = t.id then r.related_contract_id else r.contract_id end
      where (r.contract_id = t.id or r.related_contract_id = t.id)
        and n.deleted_at is null and (n.status='ACTIVE' or n.contract_end > t.eff_end))
    and ( t.owner_id = (select auth.uid())
          or exists (select 1 from mso_manage.user_profiles me where me.id=(select auth.uid()) and me.active='Y' and coalesce(me.is_admin,false)) )
  order by t.eff_end desc;
$function$
name: get_contract_cleanup_candidates

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.get_contract_expiry_alert_candidates(p_alert_days integer DEFAULT 60, p_expired_days integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, doc_no text, contract_title text, counterparty_name text, owner_id uuid, owner_name text, clinic_name text, clinic_names_display text, effective_end_date date, auto_renew text, has_period text, has_warranty text, contract_end date, warranty_end date)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not (mso_manage.has_level('contracts/list','user') or mso_manage.has_level('contracts/detail','user')) then
    raise exception '계약 정보 조회 권한이 없습니다.';
  end if;

  -- p_expired_days > 0 이면 최근 p_expired_days일 이내에 만료된 계약(ACTIVE 미처리분 + EXPIRED)도 함께 반환한다.
  return query
  select
    c.id, c.doc_no, c.contract_title, c.counterparty_name,
    c.owner_id, c.owner_name, c.clinic_name, c.clinic_names_display,
    greatest(
      case when c.has_period = 'Y' then c.contract_end end,
      case when c.has_warranty = 'Y' then c.warranty_end end
    ) as effective_end_date,
    c.auto_renew, c.has_period, c.has_warranty, c.contract_end, c.warranty_end
  from mso_manage.contracts c
  where c.deleted_at is null
    and c.owner_id is not null
    and (
      c.status = 'ACTIVE'
      or (p_expired_days > 0 and c.status = 'EXPIRED')
    )
    and greatest(
          case when c.has_period = 'Y' then c.contract_end end,
          case when c.has_warranty = 'Y' then c.warranty_end end
        ) between (current_date - greatest(p_expired_days, 0)) and (current_date + p_alert_days);
end;
$function$
name: get_contract_expiry_alert_candidates

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.get_item_name_mismatches()
 RETURNS TABLE(item_code text, master_name text, source_table text, record_name text, record_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'mso_manage'
AS $function$
begin
  if not (mso_manage.current_user_is_admin() or mso_manage.has_level('master/supply','manager')) then
    raise exception '자재 마스터 관리 권한이 없습니다.';
  end if;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT i.item_code, i.item_name, 'closing_stock'::text, cs.item_name, count(*)
  FROM mso_manage.closing_stock cs
  JOIN mso_manage.items i ON i.item_code = cs.item_code
  WHERE cs.item_name IS DISTINCT FROM i.item_name
  GROUP BY i.item_code, i.item_name, cs.item_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT i.item_code, i.item_name, 'purchase_records'::text, pr.item_name, count(*)
  FROM public.purchase_records pr
  JOIN mso_manage.items i ON i.item_code = pr.item_code
  WHERE pr.item_name IS DISTINCT FROM i.item_name
  GROUP BY i.item_code, i.item_name, pr.item_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT i.item_code, i.item_name, 'usage_records'::text, ur.item_name, count(*)
  FROM public.usage_records ur
  JOIN mso_manage.items i ON i.item_code = ur.item_code
  WHERE ur.item_name IS DISTINCT FROM i.item_name
  GROUP BY i.item_code, i.item_name, ur.item_name

  ORDER BY 1, 3, 4;
end;
$function$
name: get_item_name_mismatches

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.get_my_insights()

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
 select i.id, i.area, i.rule_key, i.clinic_code, i.team_code, i.severity, i.title, i.summary, i.detail, i.link_page, i.first_seen_at, i.changed_at,
   coalesce((select a.acked_at >= i.changed_at from mso_manage.insight_acks a where a.insight_id=i.id and a.user_id=me.id), false),
   case when i.area='equipment' and me.equipment_role='dept_manager' then 'practical' else 'primary' end
 from mso_manage.insights i
 join mso_manage.user_profiles me on me.id = (select auth.uid()) and me.active='Y'
 where i.status='open' and (
   (i.area='stock_inout' and (
      coalesce(me.is_admin,false)
      or exists (select 1 from mso_manage.alert_owners o where o.area='stock_inout' and o.clinic_code=i.clinic_code and o.user_id=me.id)
      or exists (select 1 from mso_manage.alert_extra_viewers x where x.user_id=me.id and x.area='stock_inout' and x.clinic_code=i.clinic_code)))
   or (i.area='contract' and (
      coalesce(me.is_admin,false)
      or ( (coalesce(nullif(me.page_perms->>'contracts/list',''),'접근불가') <> '접근불가' or coalesce(nullif(me.page_perms->>'contracts/detail',''),'접근불가') <> '접근불가')
           and ( (i.detail->>'owner_id') = me.id::text
                 or exists (select 1 from mso_manage.alert_extra_viewers x where x.user_id=me.id and x.area='contract' and x.clinic_code='ALL') ))))
   or (i.area='equipment' and (
      coalesce(me.is_admin,false)
      or me.equipment_role='mso_lead'
      or (me.equipment_role='clinic_admin' and (me.role='all_clinic' or me.clinic_code=i.clinic_code))

      or exists (select 1 from mso_manage.alert_extra_viewers x where x.user_id=me.id and x.area='equipment' and x.clinic_code=i.clinic_code)))
 )
 order by case i.severity when 'urgent' then 1 when 'todo' then 2 else 3 end, i.changed_at desc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.get_stock_review(p_kind text, p_clinic text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(clinic_code text, ym text, item_code text, item_name text, item_type text, stock numeric, amount numeric, use3 numeric, months numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
  with me as (select id, coalesce(is_admin,false) adm from mso_manage.user_profiles where id = (select auth.uid()) and active='Y'),
  allowed as (
    select distinct c.clinic_code from mso_manage.closing_stock c, me where me.adm
    union select o.clinic_code from mso_manage.alert_owners o, me where o.area='stock_inout' and o.user_id=me.id
    union select x.clinic_code from mso_manage.alert_extra_viewers x, me where x.area='stock_inout' and x.user_id=me.id
  ),
  m as (select c.clinic_code, max(c.ym) latest from mso_manage.closing_stock c
        where c.clinic_code in (select a.clinic_code from allowed a) and (p_clinic is null or c.clinic_code = p_clinic) group by 1),
  r as (
    select c.clinic_code, c.item_code, max(c.item_name) nm, max(c.item_type) tp, m.latest,
      coalesce(sum(c.closing_qty) filter (where c.ym = m.latest),0) stock,
      coalesce(sum(c.closing_amount) filter (where c.ym = m.latest),0) amt,
      coalesce(sum(c.decrease_qty) filter (where c.ym > to_char(to_date(m.latest||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') - interval '3 months','YYYY-MM')),0) use3
    from mso_manage.closing_stock c join m using (clinic_code) group by c.clinic_code, c.item_code, m.latest
  )
  select r.clinic_code, r.latest, r.item_code, r.nm, r.tp, r.stock, r.amt, r.use3,
         case when r.use3 > 0 then round(r.stock / (r.use3/3.0), 1) end
  from r
  where r.stock > 0 and ((p_kind = 'over' and r.use3 > 0 and r.stock > r.use3) or (p_kind = 'nouse' and r.use3 = 0))
  order by r.clinic_code, 9 desc nulls last, r.amt desc;
$function$
name: get_stock_review

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.process_contract_expiry_and_renewal()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
  v_start date;
  v_end date;
  v_today date := ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date);
begin
  for r in
    select id, contract_start, contract_end, auto_renew_cycle_months
    from mso_manage.contracts
    where status = 'ACTIVE'
      and auto_renew = 'Y'
      and contract_end is not null
      and auto_renew_cycle_months is not null
      and auto_renew_cycle_months > 0
      and contract_end < v_today
  loop
    v_start := r.contract_start;
    v_end := r.contract_end;
    while v_end < v_today loop
      -- 다음 주기: 이전 종료일 다음날부터 시작, 주기(개월)만큼 지난 전날까지
      -- date + interval 연산 결과는 timestamp가 되어 그 뒤 "- 1"(integer)이 실패하므로, 괄호로 먼저 date로 캐스팅한 뒤 1을 뺀다.
      v_start := v_end + 1;
      v_end := (v_start + (r.auto_renew_cycle_months || ' months')::interval)::date - 1;
    end loop;

    update mso_manage.contracts
    set contract_start = v_start, contract_end = v_end, updated_at = now()
    where id = r.id;

    insert into mso_manage.contract_renewals (contract_id, previous_end, new_end)
    values (r.id, r.contract_end, v_end);
  end loop;

  -- 계약기간(contract_end)이 지났어도, 유지(하자)보수기간이 아직 끝나지 않았다면
  -- 계약 자체는 아직 유효한 관계로 보고 "진행중" 상태를 유지한다.
  -- (유지보수기간도 함께 끝났거나 애초에 없으면 기존과 동일하게 계약기간 기준으로 만료 처리)
  update mso_manage.contracts
  set status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = now()
  where status = 'ACTIVE'
    and contract_end is not null
    and contract_end < v_today
    and not (auto_renew = 'Y' and auto_renew_cycle_months is not null and auto_renew_cycle_months > 0)
    and not (has_warranty = 'Y' and warranty_end is not null and warranty_end >= v_today);
end;
$function$
name: process_contract_expiry_and_renewal

       or coalesce(new.is_program_manager,false) is distinct from false

       or new.clinic_code is not null

      raise exception '권한 관련 필드(page_perms/is_admin/담당자 플래그/role/clinic_code)는 관리자만 설정할 수 있습니다.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.reassign_equipment_task(p_equipment_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_eq mso_manage.equipments%rowtype; v_new mso_manage.user_profiles%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_eq from mso_manage.equipments where id = p_equipment_id;
  if not found then return; end if;
  select up.* into v_new from mso_manage.user_profiles up
  where up.active = 'Y' and up.email is not null and (
        (up.equipment_role = 'dept_manager' and up.clinic_code = v_eq.clinic_code and up.team_code = v_eq.team_code)
     or ((up.equipment_role = 'clinic_admin' or up.is_admin) and up.clinic_code = v_eq.clinic_code)
     or up.equipment_role = 'mso_lead' or up.is_admin)
  order by case
      when up.equipment_role = 'dept_manager' then 1
      when (up.equipment_role = 'clinic_admin' or up.is_admin) and up.clinic_code = v_eq.clinic_code then 2
      when up.equipment_role = 'mso_lead' then 3 else 4 end, up.user_name
  limit 1;
  if v_new.email is not null then
    update mso_manage.task_items
      set user_email = v_new.email, clinic_code = v_eq.clinic_code, work_clinic_code = v_eq.clinic_code,
          work_clinic_name = v_eq.clinic_name, team_code = v_eq.team_code, team_name = v_eq.team_name,
          department = coalesce(v_eq.clinic_name,'') || ' / ' || coalesce(v_eq.team_name,''),
          description = description || ' (담당자 변경으로 ' || coalesce(v_new.user_name, v_new.email) || '님에게 이관됨)',
          updated_at = now()
      where linked_equipment_id = p_equipment_id and status <> 'DONE' and user_email is distinct from v_new.email;
  end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.run_insight_scan()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date;
  v_n_gen int; v_n_res int;
begin
  create temp table _gen (
    area text, rule_key text, dedupe_key text, clinic_code text, team_code text,
    severity text, title text, summary text, detail jsonb, link_page text
  ) on commit drop;

  -- ── 계약: 만료 임박 (계약별) ─────────────────────────────
  insert into _gen
  select 'contract','c_expiring','c_expiring:'||c.id, null, null,
    case when x.eff_end - v_today <= 14 then 'urgent' else 'todo' end,
    '계약 만료 임박 · '||coalesce(c.contract_title, c.counterparty_name, c.doc_no),
    coalesce(c.counterparty_name,'')||' · '||to_char(x.eff_end,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' 만료 (D-'||(x.eff_end - v_today)||')',
    jsonb_build_object('contract_id',c.id,'owner_id',c.owner_id,'owner_name',c.owner_name,'end',x.eff_end,'dday',x.eff_end - v_today,'counterparty',c.counterparty_name,'auto_renew',coalesce(c.auto_renew,'N')),
    'contracts/detail'
  from mso_manage.contracts c
  cross join lateral (select case when c.has_warranty='Y' and c.warranty_end is not null and c.warranty_end > coalesce(c.contract_end,'1900-01-01') then c.warranty_end else c.contract_end end eff_end) x
  where c.deleted_at is null and c.status='ACTIVE' and c.has_period='Y'
    and x.eff_end between v_today and v_today+60;

  -- ── 계약: 정리 대기 (만료 후 30일 경과, 후속 계약 없음, 1년 이내) — 담당자별 묶음 ──
  insert into _gen
  select 'contract','c_missed','c_missed:'||coalesce(t.owner_id::text,'none'), null, null,
    'todo',
    '계약 정리 대기 '||count(*)||'건',
    '만료 후 후속 계약·종료 처리가 없는 계약입니다 (재계약 / 종료 확인 필요)',
    jsonb_build_object('owner_id',t.owner_id,'owner_name',max(t.owner_name),'count',count(*),
      'items',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('contract_id',s.id,'title',s.nm,'counterparty',s.counterparty_name,'end',s.eff_end) order by s.eff_end desc)
               from (select * from (
                  select c2.id, coalesce(c2.contract_title,c2.counterparty_name,c2.doc_no) nm, c2.counterparty_name, c2.owner_id,
                         case when c2.has_warranty='Y' and c2.warranty_end > c2.contract_end then c2.warranty_end else c2.contract_end end eff_end
                  from mso_manage.contracts c2 where c2.id = any(array_agg(t.id))) q order by eff_end desc limit 5) s)),
    'contracts/list'
  from (
    select c.id, c.owner_id, c.owner_name,
           case when c.has_warranty='Y' and c.warranty_end > c.contract_end then c.warranty_end else c.contract_end end eff_end,
           c.counterparty_name
    from mso_manage.contracts c
    where c.deleted_at is null and c.status='EXPIRED' and c.has_period='Y' and c.cleanup_checked_at is null
  ) t
  where t.eff_end between v_today-365 and v_today-30
    and not exists (
      select 1 from mso_manage.contract_relations r
      join mso_manage.contracts n on n.id = case when r.contract_id = t.id then r.related_contract_id else r.contract_id end
      where (r.contract_id = t.id or r.related_contract_id = t.id)
        and n.deleted_at is null and (n.status='ACTIVE' or n.contract_end > t.eff_end))
  group by t.owner_id;

  -- ── 의료장비: 유지보수 만료 임박 (장비별) ───────────────────
  insert into _gen
  select 'equipment','e_expiring','e_expiring:'||e.id, e.clinic_code, e.team_code,
    case when e.maintenance_end_date - v_today <= 14 then 'urgent' else 'todo' end,
    '유지보수 종료 임박 · '||e.equipment_name,
    e.clinic_name||' '||e.team_name||' · '||to_char(e.maintenance_end_date,'YYYY-MM-DD')||' (D-'||(e.maintenance_end_date - v_today)||')',
    jsonb_build_object('equipment_id',e.id,'name',e.equipment_name,'serial',coalesce(e.serial_no,e.equipment_no),'end',e.maintenance_end_date,'dday',e.maintenance_end_date - v_today,'clinic_name',e.clinic_name,'team_name',e.team_name),
    'equipment/detail'
  from mso_manage.equipments e
  where e.deleted_yn='N' and e.status is distinct from 'DISPOSED' and e.maintenance_mode='ACTIVE'
    and e.maintenance_end_date between v_today and v_today+30;

  -- ── 의료장비: 유지보수 방식 확인 필요 / 종료됨 (의원×팀 묶음) ──
  insert into _gen
  select 'equipment','e_unchecked','e_unchecked:'||e.clinic_code||':'||e.team_code, e.clinic_code, e.team_code,
    'todo',
    '유지보수 확인 필요 '||count(*)||'대 · '||max(e.team_name),
    max(e.clinic_name)||' '||max(e.team_name)||' — 유지보수 방식 미설정 '||count(*) filter (where e.maintenance_mode='UNCHECKED')||'대, 종료됨 '||count(*) filter (where e.maintenance_mode='ACTIVE')||'대',
    jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'unchecked',count(*) filter (where e.maintenance_mode='UNCHECKED'),'ended',count(*) filter (where e.maintenance_mode='ACTIVE'),
       'clinic_name',max(e.clinic_name),'team_name',max(e.team_name)),
    'equipment/list'
  from mso_manage.equipments e
  where e.deleted_yn='N' and e.status is distinct from 'DISPOSED'
    and (e.maintenance_mode='UNCHECKED' or (e.maintenance_mode='ACTIVE' and e.maintenance_end_date < v_today))
  group by e.clinic_code, e.team_code;

  -- ── 재고: 3개월분 초과 / 최근 3개월 사용 없음 (의원별 묶음) ────────
  insert into _gen
  with m as (select clinic_code, max(ym) latest from mso_manage.closing_stock group by 1),
  r as (
    select c.clinic_code, c.item_code, max(c.item_name) nm, m.latest,
      coalesce(sum(c.closing_qty) filter (where c.ym = m.latest),0) stock,
      coalesce(sum(c.decrease_qty) filter (where c.ym > to_char(to_date(m.latest||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') - interval '3 months','YYYY-MM')),0) use3
    from mso_manage.closing_stock c join m using (clinic_code) group by c.clinic_code, c.item_code, m.latest
  ),
  over_items as (
    select *, round(stock / (use3/3.0), 1) months from r where stock>0 and use3>0 and stock>use3
  ),
  noused as (select * from r where stock>0 and use3=0)
  select 'stock_inout','s_over','s_over:'||o.clinic_code, o.clinic_code, null, 'todo',
    '재고 과다 의심 '||count(*)||'건',
    '현재 재고가 최근 3개월 사용량보다 많은 자재입니다 (수량 기준, 마감 '||max(o.latest)||')',
    jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'ym',max(o.latest),
      'items',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',q.item_code,'name',q.nm,'stock',q.stock,'use3',q.use3,'months',q.months) order by q.months desc)
               from (select * from over_items o2 where o2.clinic_code=o.clinic_code order by months desc limit 5) q)),
    'management/statistics'
  from over_items o group by o.clinic_code
  union all
  select 'stock_inout','s_nouse','s_nouse:'||n.clinic_code, n.clinic_code, null, 'info',
    '최근 3개월 사용 없는 재고 '||count(*)||'건',
    '재고는 있지만 최근 3개월간 사용이 없는 자재입니다 (마감 '||max(n.latest)||')',
    jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'ym',max(n.latest),
      'items',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',q.item_code,'name',q.nm,'stock',q.stock) order by q.stock desc)
               from (select * from noused n2 where n2.clinic_code=n.clinic_code order by stock desc limit 5) q)),
    'management/statistics'
  from noused n group by n.clinic_code;

  select count(*) into v_n_gen from _gen;

  -- upsert (내용이 바뀌면 changed_at 갱신, 해결됐다 재발하면 확인 기록 초기화)
  delete from mso_manage.insight_acks a using mso_manage.insights i, _gen g
    where a.insight_id=i.id and i.dedupe_key=g.dedupe_key and i.status='resolved';

  insert into mso_manage.insights (area, rule_key, dedupe_key, clinic_code, team_code, severity, title, summary, detail, link_page, status, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, changed_at, sig)
  select area, rule_key, dedupe_key, clinic_code, team_code, severity, title, summary, detail, link_page, 'open', now(), now(), now(), md5(severity||detail::text)
  from _gen
  on conflict (dedupe_key) do update set
    clinic_code=excluded.clinic_code, team_code=excluded.team_code, severity=excluded.severity, title=excluded.title,
    summary=excluded.summary, detail=excluded.detail, link_page=excluded.link_page, last_seen_at=now(),
    changed_at = case when mso_manage.insights.sig is distinct from excluded.sig or mso_manage.insights.status='resolved' then now() else mso_manage.insights.changed_at end,
    first_seen_at = case when mso_manage.insights.status='resolved' then now() else mso_manage.insights.first_seen_at end,
    sig = excluded.sig, status='open', resolved_at=null, snoozed_until=null;

  update mso_manage.insights set status='resolved', resolved_at=now()
  where status<>'resolved' and dedupe_key not in (select dedupe_key from _gen);
  get diagnostics v_n_res = row_count;

  return jsonb_build_object('generated', v_n_gen, 'resolved', v_n_res, 'date', v_today);
end $function$
name: run_insight_scan

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.search_equipment_fuzzy(p_query text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 15)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, equipment_name text, model_name text, team_name text, clinic_name text, manufacturer text, serial_no text, vendor text, manager_name text, manager_phone text, purchase_date date, maintenance_end_date date, status text, location text, current_user_name text, memo text, hira_registered boolean, hira_barcode text, created_at timestamp with time zone, score real)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'extensions', 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    e.id, e.equipment_name, e.model_name, e.team_name, e.clinic_name,
    e.manufacturer, e.serial_no, e.vendor, e.manager_name, e.manager_phone,
    e.purchase_date, e.maintenance_end_date, e.status, e.location,
    e.current_user_name, e.memo, e.hira_registered, e.hira_barcode, e.created_at,
    similarity(regexp_replace(e.equipment_name, '\s+', '', 'g'), regexp_replace(p_query, '\s+', '', 'g')) as score
  from mso_manage.equipments e
  where e.deleted_yn = 'N'
    and (
      regexp_replace(e.equipment_name, '\s+', '', 'g') ilike '%' || regexp_replace(p_query, '\s+', '', 'g') || '%'
      or exists (
        select 1 from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(trim(p_query), '\s+')) as t
        having bool_and(e.equipment_name ilike '%' || t || '%')
      )
      or similarity(regexp_replace(e.equipment_name, '\s+', '', 'g'), regexp_replace(p_query, '\s+', '', 'g')) > 0.2
    )
  order by score desc, e.equipment_name
  limit p_limit;
$function$
name: search_equipment_fuzzy

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.survey_notices()
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, survey_id uuid, public_code text, title text, ends_at date, days_left integer, resp_count bigint, mode text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
  select 'todo'::text, s.id, s.public_code, s.title, s.ends_at,
         (s.ends_at - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date)::int, null::bigint, s.mode
    from mso_manage.surveys s
   where s.mode in ('staff_anon','staff_named') and mso_manage.survey_is_open(s)
     and exists (select 1 from mso_manage.user_profiles where id = auth.uid() and active = 'Y')
     and mso_manage.has_level('survey/respond','user','user')
     and not exists (select 1 from mso_manage.survey_participants p where p.survey_id = s.id and p.user_id = auth.uid())
  union all
  select 'closing'::text, s.id, s.public_code, s.title, s.ends_at,
         (s.ends_at - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date)::int,
         (select count(*) from mso_manage.survey_responses r where r.survey_id = s.id), s.mode
    from mso_manage.surveys s
   where s.owner_id = auth.uid() and mso_manage.survey_is_open(s)
     and s.ends_at - (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date <= 2
  order by 1, 6;
$function$
name: survey_notices

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.survey_open_for_me()

 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
  select case when s.mode = 'public' then md5('linkonly:' || s.id::text) else s.public_code end,
         case when s.mode = 'public' then '링크로 참여하는 설문' else s.title end,
         case when s.mode = 'public' then null else s.description end,
         s.ends_at, s.mode,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.survey_purge_expired()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
declare s record; total int := 0; today date := (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date;
begin
  for s in
    select id from mso_manage.surveys
    where retention_days is not null and purged_at is null and status <> 'draft' and ends_at is not null
      and least(coalesce((closed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date, ends_at), ends_at) + retention_days < today
  loop
    total := total + mso_manage._survey_anonymize(s.id);
  end loop;
  return total;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mso_manage.trg_fn_user_equipment_manager_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'mso_manage', 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_eq_id uuid;
begin
  if new.is_equipment_manager is distinct from old.is_equipment_manager
     or new.equipment_role is distinct from old.equipment_role
     or (new.page_perms->>'equipment/form') is distinct from (old.page_perms->>'equipment/form')
     or new.clinic_code is distinct from old.clinic_code
     or new.team_code is distinct from old.team_code
     or new.active is distinct from old.active
  then
    for v_eq_id in
      select distinct linked_equipment_id from mso_manage.task_items
      where user_email = old.email and linked_equipment_id is not null and status <> 'DONE'
    loop
      perform mso_manage.reassign_equipment_task(v_eq_id);
    end loop;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stats_hold(p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_basic jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_conds jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare w text := public.stats_where_(p_filters, p_basic, p_conds); res jsonb;
begin
  execute format($f$
    with b as (select *, row_number() over (order by ym, uploaded_at, id) rn from public.usage_records
               where %s and stock_hold_days is not null and stock_hold_days >= 0),
    k as (select b.rn, b.stock_hold_days h, coalesce(b.usage_total,0) a, b.item_name raw_name,
                 btrim(coalesce(b.item_code,'')) code, coalesce(nullif(b.item_name,''),'(미확인)') nm,
                 case when b.stock_hold_days <= 30 then 0 when b.stock_hold_days <= 60 then 1 when b.stock_hold_days <= 90 then 2
                      when b.stock_hold_days <= 180 then 3 when b.stock_hold_days <= 365 then 4 else 5 end bi
          from b)
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'buckets', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('i', bi, 'count', c, 'amount', s) order by bi)
                           from (select bi, count(*) c, sum(a) s from k group by bi) x), '[]'::jsonb),
      'total_rows', (select count(*) from k),
      'total_amt', (select coalesce(sum(a),0) from k),
      'w_sum', (select coalesce(sum(a * h),0) from k),
      'n90', (select count(*) from k where h > 90),
      'long_amt', (select coalesce(sum(a),0) from k where h > 180),
      'max_hold', (select max(h) from k),
      'max_name', (select coalesce(raw_name,'') from k order by h desc, rn limit 1),
      'median', (select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by h) from k where a > 0),
      'items', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code', code, 'name', name, 'usage', usage, 'w_sum', w_sum,
                                'max_hold', max_hold, 'long_amt', long_amt) order by rn)
                         from (select max(code) code, (array_agg(nm order by rn))[1] name, sum(a) usage, sum(a * h) w_sum,
                                      max(h) max_hold, coalesce(sum(a) filter (where h > 180),0) long_amt, min(rn) rn
                               from k group by case when code <> '' then 'code:' || code else 'name:' || nm end) y
                         where long_amt > 0), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) $f$, w) into res;
  return res;
end $function$
args: p_filters jsonb, p_basic jsonb, p_conds jsonb
name: stats_hold
